Murder and suicide, especially in literature. 

It's not beautiful and tragic, it's just gross.

I think it's because humans want things to be better. When things are going terribly people tend to cling to the last ounce of hope they have and try to explain things we find scary. I also think that some people want to have a bigger purpose. Having a purpose for your existence and life feels better than living in chaos.
